name: thread_ledger
title: A dropped thread is not a contradiction, so nothing else would find it
summary: A thread opened in beat 1 and untouched since is perfectly consistent. No fact conflicts, no dependency is stale, and every continuity check passes, which is exactly why a serial needs a ledger that tracks it separately. For audio fiction, a dropped thread is the most expensive kind of mistake.

steps.title: A question is opened
steps.note: Beat 1 raises it: who told the Warden Kael's name?

steps.title: Four beats later, nothing has touched it
steps.note: The audit reports it. Not a contradiction, an omission, and the only place in the system that would ever notice.

flags.message: “Who told the Warden Kael's name?” has been open since Caught in the market and nothing has touched it for 4 beats. Pay it off, advance it, or drop it deliberately.
